values.meaning: duration of bonus movement speed / ghosting before dagger lands

mechanics.claim: Preparation tosses a Dagger into the air above Katarina's current location that lands after the movement speed duration ends.
mechanics.quote: tosses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} into the air above her current location and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays until it lands after {{fd|1.25}} seconds
